# dtcloud_vm_network_interface (Resource)

Attaches an extra network interface to a virtual machine.

Interfaces declared in a `dtcloud_vm` `network` block are created with the machine and live and die with it. This resource is for the ones added afterwards: they get their own port and can be detached without recreating the machine.

The resource ID is `<vm-id>:<port-id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An interface added after the machine was built. It has its own lifecycle and
# can be detached without recreating the VM.
resource "dtcloud_vm_network_interface" "storage" {
  vm_id           = dtcloud_vm.web.id
  network_id      = dtcloud_network.storage.id
  security_groups = [dtcloud_security_group.internal.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fixed_ip` (Block List, Min: 1) Fixed IPs on this interface. At least one is required. Can be changed in place. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--fixed_ip))
- `network_id` (String) ID of the network to attach to.
- `vm_id` (String) ID of the virtual machine to attach the interface to.

### Optional

- `port_security_enabled` (Boolean) Whether port security (and therefore security groups) applies to this interface.
- `security_groups` (List of String) Security group IDs bound to this interface. Can be changed in place.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether the interface is on a public network.
- `mac_address` (String) MAC address the platform assigned to this interface.
- `network_name` (String) Name of the network.
- `port_id` (String) ID of the port the platform created for this interface.
- `primary_ip` (String) Primary IP address on this interface.

<a id="nestedblock--fixed_ip"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fixed_ip`

Optional:

- `ip_address` (String) Specific address to request. Allocated by the platform when omitted.
- `ip_version` (Number) IP version, 4 or 6.


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String)
- `delete` (String)
- `update` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# The port id is assigned by the platform at attach time:
# <vm-id>:<port-id>
terraform import dtcloud_vm_network_interface.storage 4c9a1f37-8d25-4e60-b13f-6a7c2e5b9d88:0b3e6a92-7c14-4d58-9f26-8e1a5c7b3f99
```
